text: On December 20, 2017, the City received an application to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law for 41 Chatsworth Drive (the "Current Application"). The Current Application proposed a 4 storey residential condominium building containing 43 units and 8,667 square metres of gross floor area resulting in an overall site density of 1.96 times the site area. The proposed building would be 4-storeys facing Chatsworth Drive and 5-storeys facing Duplex Parkette. The Current Application was deemed complete on January 18, 2018. The applicant appealed City Council's neglect or failure to make a decision on its application for Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendments (the "Appeals") to the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal (the "LPAT") on October 21, 2019.
